category: Static geospatial foundations for a basin-centric PostGIS model
summary: Researched 2026-08-22 with live fetches. Key findings for Washington: (1) WBD/NHD/NHDPlus HR are frozen legacy products (USGS moved to 3DHP in 2024); the WBD REST service and the NHDPlus HR HU4-1711 geodatabase on prd-tnm are the stable static inputs, and all six target basins are fully resolvable to HUC8/HUC10 (21 HUC8s in 1711, 51 HUC10s across the target HUC8s, 511 HUC12s). (2) 3DHP already serves 58k flowlines with hydrosequence/levelpath attributes in the Skagit bbox but zero catchments there (workunitid='NHD', i.e. legacy-derived), so catchments must still come from NHDPlus HR. (3) NLDI and the NWS/NWM reach IDs are NHDPlusV2 (medium-res) COMIDs, not NHDPlus HR IDs; the NWPS reachId for CONW1 (24270512) equals the NHDPlusV2 COMID returned by NLDI at that point, so a COMID crosswalk table is essential. (4) Legacy StreamStats services were decommissioned 2026-01-30; SS-Delineate and SS-Hydro work for WA (4.8 s delineation). (5) The Lynker-Spatial NextGen hydrofabric bucket lists but anonymous object GETs now return 403, and its v2.2 license.txt says CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 while NOAA docs say ODbL; treat as blocked/uncertain for commercial use. (6) 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (NAD83 GCS, NAVD88 m) and 1 m (NAD83 UTM 10N, NAVD88 m) are on prd-tnm with ~25 WA 1 m projects; WA DNR lidar is in NAD83(HARN) State Plane N/S US-survey-feet with NAVD88 ftUS heights. (7) FEMA NFHL REST (EPSG:4269, monthly) covers King/Pierce/Snohomish/Whatcom but Skagit County (53057C) has ZERO NFHL polygons or panels: Skagit flood maps are ~40-year-old paper FIRMs, a hard gap for the flagship basin. (8) USACE NLD exposes 339 WA leveed areas via ArcGIS FeatureServer and a 155-path JSON API. (9) NWPS has 285 WA gauges (200 with USGS IDs, 73 with flood stages); 126 report gauge datums in NGVD29 vs 61 in NAVD88, while USGS now publishes NAVD88 altitudes; NGS NCAT (VERTCON 3.0) gives NAVD88 = NGVD29 + 1.07 to 1.20 m (3.50 to 3.93 ft) across the Puget Sound gauges, which exactly explains the NWPS-vs-USGS datum discrepancies observed (e.g., Cedar at Renton 15.2 ft NGVD29 vs 18.77 ft NAVD88). (10) Legacy waterservices.usgs.gov is decommissioned Q1 2027; use api.waterdata.usgs.gov OGC API (X-Api-Key). (11) Ecology GIS data carries a 'commercial use prohibited' clause; TIGER, 3DEP, NFHL, NLD are public domain; OSM/Geofabrik/Microsoft/Overture buildings are ODbL.
